title: Petlibro Portion Consistency Drift
app: Fi collar, Petkit, Tractive, Petlibro, Litter-Robot, pet cameras, and aquarium controllers via vendor exports, Home Assistant integrations, MQTT, and Splunk HEC.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=petlibro:feeder
| stats avg(portion_g) as avg_portion_g, stdev(portion_g) as portion_sd_g by feeder meal_name
| where avg_portion_g>0 AND portion_sd_g>avg_portion_g*0.15
| sort - portion_sd_g
description: Uses Petlibro dispensing logs telemetry to monitor consistency of dispensed meal portions in index=personal.
value: Splunk turns the feed into an operational check for feeders that are drifting away from reliable servings, so the signal does not stay buried inside separate consumer apps or exports.
implementation: Ingest Petlibro dispensing logs data through its real API, export, MQTT bridge, or open-source connector into `index=personal`; preserve the fields referenced in the SPL and schedule the search on a daily cadence.
visualization: Meal table of average portion and standard deviation.
grandmaExplanation: It blends consistency of dispensed meal portions so you can spot feeders that are drifting away from reliable servings before it becomes annoying.
